title: Twin Roots Foods: Regenerated logo asset + header/footer bounce on load and route changes

requirements.summary: Add a newly generated, more detailed Twin Roots Foods circular logo PNG as a static frontend asset (logo-v5).
acceptanceCriteria: A new PNG logo asset exists under frontend/public/assets/generated/ with the filename specified in the image requirements.
The logo keeps a circular emblem with spice/ingredient line-art and an earthy palette, and is more detailed than the current logo.
The logo text reads exactly “Twin Roots Foods” and the tagline reads exactly “Rooted in Purity” (spelling/case/punctuation match).

file_operations.description: Add the regenerated detailed circular spice/ingredient line-art emblem PNG with integrated text “Twin Roots Foods” and curved tagline “Rooted in Purity” as a static asset (do not serve via backend).

requirements.summary: Update the header logo to use the newly generated logo-v5 asset while keeping appropriate English alt text.
acceptanceCriteria: Header renders the new logo asset (not logo-v4).
Header logo alt text remains in English and remains appropriate for the brand (e.g., “Twin Roots Foods”).

file_operations.description: Replace the header logo image source from the current generated logo to use the new static asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/logo-v5.dim_512x512.png, keeping alt text as “Twin Roots Foods”.

requirements.summary: Add a footer logo image (using logo-v5) next to the footer branding text without breaking responsiveness.
acceptanceCriteria: Footer displays the new logo image alongside the existing footer brand text/tagline.
The footer remains responsive and does not break the existing footer grid layout.

file_operations.description: Add a logo image using frontend/public/assets/generated/logo-v5.dim_512x512.png in the footer branding area near the “Twin Roots Foods” text, ensuring the existing grid layout remains intact and responsive.

requirements.summary: Add a noticeable bounce animation that plays on initial load and on internal route changes for the header and footer logo images only.
acceptanceCriteria: On initial page load, the header logo and footer logo each play a noticeable bounce animation once.
On internal navigation (changing routes within the SPA), the header logo and footer logo each play the bounce animation again.
Animation is applied to the logo image element(s) only (not the whole header/footer containers).
All user-facing text remains English (no new non-English strings introduced as part of this change).

file_operations.description: Add a custom, noticeable logo-bounce keyframes/animation utility (e.g., a stronger bounce than the default) that can be applied to the logo elements.

Create a hook that observes TanStack Router location changes and produces a changing key/value on initial load and route changes, so logo images can remount/restart the bounce animation each navigation.

Create a shared BrandLogo component that renders the logo with the bounce animation class and uses the route-change key (from useLogoBounceKey) to replay the animation on initial load and internal navigation.

Wire the header to render the new BrandLogo component (or apply the bounce animation behavior to the header logo only), ensuring the bounce replays on route changes and not on the entire header container.

Wire the footer to render the same BrandLogo component (or apply the bounce animation behavior to the footer logo only), ensuring the bounce replays on route changes and not on the entire footer container.
